atAGlance: Cà phê đen đá is the stripped-down iced robusta order, bold, bitter-edged, and slowly softened by ice at sidewalk coffee tables.
whatItIs: Cà phê đen đá is phin-brewed robusta served over ice, usually without milk. Expect black iced coffee with a bold roasted edge, light bitterness, and a clean finish once the ice melts in.
howToEnjoy: Drink it slowly as the ice opens it up; add sugar only if you want to soften the roast.
howLocalsOrder: Cà phê đen đá is the sharper black iced coffee order. Ask for sugar on the side if you want control, then let the ice soften the strong roasted edge.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Cà phê đen đá is the stripped-down side of Vietnamese coffee culture, where robusta strength is the point rather than something to hide.
goodToKnow: It can be much stronger than a typical iced Americano.
